description: This file defines classes and functions related to module importers in the torch.package system, including custom error classes, an abstract base class 'Importer', a default system importer '_SysImporter', and a composite 'OrderedImporter'. It manages module importing, name resolution, and handles special cases like torch package dummy modules.

classes.name: ObjNotFoundError
classes.description: Raised when an importer cannot find an object by searching for its name.

classes.name: ObjMismatchError
classes.description: Raised when an importer finds a different object with the same name as the user-provided one.

classes.name: Importer
classes.description: Abstract base class representing an environment to import modules from, with methods for importing modules and getting object names.

classes.name: _SysImporter
classes.description: Default system importer implementing Python's standard import behavior.

classes.name: OrderedImporter
classes.description: A composite importer that tries multiple importers in sequence, with special handling for torch.package dummy modules.

methods.name: import_module
methods.description: Imports a module given its name, as defined in each importer class.

methods.name: get_name
methods.description: Returns the module and attribute name for a given object within the import environment.

methods.name: whichmodule
methods.description: Determines the module name an object belongs to.

methods.name: _is_torchpackage_dummy
methods.description: Checks if a module is a dummy torch.package module.
